object.attr: derived: a value converted silently, the string "false" read as true for instance, runs the call with a meaning the agent didn't intend (CF-M18). Decided on 2026-11-10. The types are those of MELLON-MCP-SRS-34 to MELLON-MCP-SRS-36.
object.description: If a tool call gives a parameter a value of a type that the parameter doesn't take, the MCP server shall refuse the call.
